firm_data.firm_description: D&S is a boutique business immigration law firm specializing in assisting entrepreneurs, start-ups, small businesses, and creative companies with their immigration needs. D&S services clients in all industries from art, architecture, and graphic design to business, finance, and technology.

email.subject: AI for DiRaimondo & Schroeder LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Marie,

D&S serves entrepreneurs, startups, and creative companies across industries from art and design to technology and finance. That client diversity, combined with specialized business immigration work, means your team handles complex, high-stakes matters that demand precision and client trust.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Brooklyn to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
